source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check EEPROM could be flash
1. Boot into UEFI shell.
2. Use  diag tool to update EEPROM.
3. Shutdown the SUT and AC.
4. power on SUT and boot into shell.
5. Use tool check the EEPROM update successfully.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Make sure EEPROM could flash successfully.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Update: update the board EEPROM (FRU) fields ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" fru edit 2 0 0 "Board Mfg"="Wistron" 2>&1; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" fru print 2>&1 | head -n 30; state-changing EEPROM write.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the FRU edit response + the re-read FRU so the user confirms the updated EEPROM field persisted after the write.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: rewriting EEPROM/FRU is persistent and can affect warranty/serial data; write only user-specified fields and keep a backup.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; warns about persistence but substitutes a guessed BMC FRU Board Mfg edit for the source's UEFI diagnostic EEPROM update.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED because target, field/image, tool semantics and recovery were absent; its critical safety boundaries are retained but missing project artifacts are readiness under V3.1.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL; repeats the non-equivalent FRU edit and lacks the UEFI/AC-cycle method.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: Confirms no write or power cycle may occur until exact target/tool/backup/recovery inputs are supplied.

original_test_intent: Use the owner-approved UEFI diagnostic tool to write a precisely identified EEPROM field or image, perform the required controlled shutdown and AC-off/on cycle, then re-read the same target to prove the update persisted and the platform recovered normally.
original_method: Boot the approved UEFI shell environment, back up and identify the exact EEPROM, execute one validated diagnostic write/verify transaction, perform one approved AC power cycle through the project method, return to the shell and read back the intended target plus platform health evidence.
manual_activity: The owner supplies and approves the target, image/field, diagnostic, backup/recovery and AC-cycle plan. The source does not require physical cable removal; with approved UEFI console/media and controllable project AC infrastructure, write, verify, cycle, reboot and readback can be automated. Any project that explicitly requires manual AC handling must record that execution constraint separately.
required_inputs: Exact EEPROM device, board/controller, mux/address or diagnostic target identifier
Approved field/value or full image/hash and expected before/after data
Vendor UEFI diagnostic package/version/exact command/prompts and supported hardware
Complete pre-write backup, write-protect handling, restore/brick recovery and stable power requirements
Approved single-user plan, UEFI boot/console path, AC-off duration/control method and OOB/KVM recovery
safety_requirements: Do not run the DeepSeek ipmitool fru edit: it targets a guessed BMC FRU field and is not equivalent to the specified UEFI EEPROM diagnostic.
Never write when device/field/image identity, compatibility, backup or recovery is unresolved; protect serial/warranty/calibration data.
Use one approved transaction, preserve full failure output and do not interrupt power until the diagnostic has completed and storage is quiescent.
Perform only the approved AC-off/on sequence; stop on write/verify mismatch, unexpected identity change, boot failure or OOB loss and never auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the EEPROM/tool/image manifest, capture complete read-only baseline and create/verify the approved backup.
After one-user approval, automate the exact UEFI diagnostic write/verify, preserve transcript and issue only the approved shutdown/AC cycle through the authorized controller.
Re-enter the UEFI shell, read back the same target, compare hash/fields, collect BIOS/BMC/SEL/boot health and report Tool Result without setting PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve exact target, write data, diagnostic and backup/recovery plan.
Approve the AC control method and remain available for physical recovery; perform any project-required manual AC action without the agent claiming it.
Review persistence and recovery evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The fru edit changes persistent BMC FRU record 2/field 0 to a fabricated value and does not reproduce the UEFI diagnostic, target, AC cycle or readback. It is explicitly rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the board/vendor-approved UEFI diagnostic and exact owner-supplied target/image/field command, plus the approved project AC control; no generic FRU edit or guessed address.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: UEFI shell, diagnostic EEPROM update, shutdown/AC cycle, shell readback and 10/10-minute fields are preserved; target data and timing are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed execution manifest and UEFI automation that captures pre-image backup/hash, exact write/verify transaction, controlled AC-off/on timestamps, post-image readback/hash and boot/management health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the EEPROM/board/diagnostic/AC topology in the approved manifest.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record EEPROM revision, board/BIOS/BMC, diagnostic, UEFI shell and AC-controller versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Use board/EEPROM vendor diagnostic, programming and recovery documentation supplied for the exact target.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes target/data/recovery and evidence atomic while retaining UEFI update and AC-cycle semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; successful write, verify, persistence across AC loss and platform recovery all remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A successful command exit is insufficient; byte/field readback and unaffected identity/boot health must be verified.

project_override_considerations: A project may select the EEPROM field/image, diagnostic, AC method and approved off-time. Missing artifacts are readiness gates, not permanent BLOCKED. A reduced or different write plan applies only to that project and must not be reported as the unspecified master update.
expected_evidence: EEPROM/board/controller identity, exact field/image/hash, diagnostic manifest and authorization
Full UEFI write/verify transcript and approved shutdown/AC-off/on/boot timeline
Post-cycle same-target readback/hash, unchanged protected fields, BIOS/BMC/SEL/boot health, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently specifies an EEPROM diagnostic update followed by AC-cycle persistence verification. It is underspecified but not internally contradictory; the FRU mismatch exists only in the historical generated command.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The update, power-cycle and persistence intent are clear. Exact target/tool/data/recovery and project AC method are high-risk readiness gates rather than permanent semantic blockers; with approved electronic control the core can be automated.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its persistence warning but rejects the FRU edit and PARTIAL classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all critical identity/backup/recovery gates but reclassifies BLOCKED to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under the locked readiness rule and source's non-physical AC wording.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves UEFI diagnostic and AC-cycle coverage, explicitly separates project AC-control method and forbids agent claims for any manual handling.

review_improvement: Prevents corrupting an unrelated FRU, provides an exact recoverable EEPROM transaction and avoids permanently blocking a clear high-risk test merely because project artifacts are absent.
independent_technical_reasoning: EEPROM programming, verification, UEFI boot control and an approved remotely controllable AC cycle are electronic operations. No literal physical cable removal is specified, so capability can be FULLY AUTOMATABLE after stringent readiness gates; execution and verdict remain unset.

no_automatic_retry: One validated EEPROM write and one approved AC cycle only. Preserve any failure and invoke the approved recovery path under engineer control; never repeat, rewrite or change images automatically.
